name: Rice Whitener Machine
description: Graintec Rice whitener cleans the surface of the rice and enhance highest quality of finished products. Sturdy, rigid, and heavy-duty construction lowers maintenance costs Whiteners are designed for superior output of whitened rice with less percentage of brokenFeatures:- Controls temperature of polished rice and allows uniform removal of bran and enhance shiny finish. Differential manometer for precise control of chamber air pressure Spring controlled whitening adjustment Quickly exchangeable screen frames with sieves Capable of handling raw, steamed, and parboiled rice.

name: Rice Silky Polisher Machines
description: Graintec Rice Silky Polisher machine is used to polish the rice grains by gentle friction in a special humidified atmosphere which is controlled by an accurate water dosing system Features:- PLC controlled automation system Capacitive Sensor for sensing product, automatic control of product flow chamber enables a sanitized processing of the rice as due to wide opening doors provided Outstanding efficiency through high output rate and minimum breakage. Integrated humidifier system with completely enclosed sieve frames with long conveyor

name: 1 HP Thick Thin Grader
description: Graintec thick & thin grader machine is used to separate different thickness grains in brown rice/ polished rice. The material is passed through revolving cylindrical screens that separate mixture of oversized & under sized grains. Features:- The changeover of one size of screen to another can be done quickly and easily by a single operator. The screens are selectable from a wide range of available slot sizes. This can also be used to separate immature grains, broken etc.

name: 2 HP Automatic Rice Length Grader Machine
description: Length grader has rotating indented cylinder to separate broken or shorter grain from whole grain by length. The full-grain length remains at the bottom of the cylinder and travels to a separate discharge outlet.Features:- The machine is equipped with sampling ports at the outlets to monitor the degree of separation Percentage of broken separation is adjustable Rigid fabricated body for smooth operation The machine is specifically designed to suit Basmati Rice, Raw Rice, Steam Rice, Parboiled Rice, and Boiled Rice.

name: 3 HP Automatic Rice Multi Grader
description: This is a unique and elegant model available in different sizes. This works on the principle of rotary. The main frame is built heavily and the screen frame is also elegantly designed. The rice is made to run over a long length for better separation of broken rice from head rice. The wooden frames are fitted with screens and bouncing balls. The screen clogged will be cleaned to maximum with the movement of bouncing balls. This is called self cleaning mechanism. The screens can be easily taken out for cleaning in case of heavy clogging.This machine is attached to an aspirator and cyclone for removal of small bran particles.

name: Pre Cleaner Machine
description: Highlights Heavy structure resulting in rigidity and longer life. Sieve box is equipped with rubber balls for self-cleaning. Key Benefits: Fitted with round scalperator to remove sticks & straws GI coated sieves which enhance to increase screen life and avoid corrosion

name: Drum Sieve Machine
description: Coarse cleaning of grain and other bulk materials reduces wear to the downstream equipment in the production process. Graintec drum sieve machine reliably eliminates coarse particles, lumps, wood chips or corncobs. The machine isessential in the reception of products Intake/Silos section/Coarse Cleaning. The material to be cleaned is guided through the inlet channel into the interior of the rotary screening drum and is turned over there. The grain falls through the screen perforations while the coarse impurities are directed to the Coarse outlet. Safety covers above all moving machine components also offer effective protection for operating personnel.Highlights:- Drum Sieve Design-Double Drum – Embedded Design, for Removing Coarse, Fines and taking Good Product Heavy duty weld mesh sieve drums completely closed and dust proof construction Heavy structure resulting in rigidity and longer life. Key Benefits: The use of high-quality components makes the machine highly resistant to wearing down. So that decreases maintenance requirements and increases the machine ‘s service life. To remove coarse impurities & large size impurities

name: Vibro Pneumatic Rubber Sheller
description: Graintec Pneumatic rubber Sheller machine is used for de-husking paddy and is fitted with two rubber rolls that run in opposite directions. Very high degree of shelling can be obtained with lesser brokens as adopted by pneumatic controls This machine comes with heavy- sturdy construction and suitable for raw, steam and boiled paddy also other grains and seeds de-hulling processFeatures:- Installed with sleeve type rubbers to get better output and yield. Machine is equipped with both automatic and manual running modes. Vibrator feed rate can be controlled by electronically Vibrator system allows uniform distribution and control over capacity.

name: Husk Aspirator Machine
description: Graintec Husk Aspirator is used for separating husk from the mixture of brown rice and paddy after shelling process. Adjustable flops that evenly separates husk and to avoid the rice conveying with husk. Only husk conveyed through the special pipeline up to husk yard. Features :- Equipped with a powerful blower for husk separation blowing husk into yard. It is equipped with dynamically balanced blower. Easy maintenance and replacement of blower fan

name: Destoner Machine
description: Graintec Vibro-Destoner precisely removes stones and other foreign impurities from the input product on the basis of their difference of densities controlled by fluid motion The machine function effectively when the product is already pre-cleaned Applicable for cleaning paddy, grains, pulses and seeds etc.Features:- Excellent separation of high-density particles such as stones, pebbles, glass and metals Built with closed circuit dust aspiration system that sucks dust and immature grains Machine inclination, air volume and vibration force can be easily adjusted Vibro motors are low noise, high life and maintenance free Sturdy, rigid & heavy-duty construction Key Benefits: Lighting system for viewing purpose Fitted with SS beading plates at glass door Self-cleaning system for optimum operating efficiency

name: Paddy Separator Machine
description: Graintec Paddy Separator machine is unique designed makes efficient separation of brown rice and paddy from the mixture based on density differences. Effectively separates in three distinct varieties: Pure paddy, brown rice and mixture. Suitable to sort all varieties of rice, such as long grain, medium grain and short grain that separates accurately.Features:- Machine is equipped with both automatic and manual running modes. Advanced automation technology easy and reliable operation. Tightly insulated and sealed doors single deck and double deck machines as per capacity
